name: Capture Timeline
description: Each government site's Arquivo.pt captures over time: a lane per section with its captures per minute, coloured by the site's answer or by any field or label the Colour by control offers, and on demand the log of any time range, runs of near-identical URLs folded into one row, beside the capture picked in full.

records.name: capture
records.one: one row of a section's arquivo-captures.csv

fields.name: site
fields.from: the section folder and its most common host
fields.how: the folder's words beside that host without www, port or user

fields.name: status_class
fields.how: 2xx, 3xx, 4xx or 5xx by its first digit, else other

fields.name: host
fields.how: the part between // and the path, as written

fields.name: decoded_url
fields.how: percent escapes decoded where they make readable text

fields.name: cited
fields.how: true when a sources.csv row names a responses file for this archive_url

fields.name: response
fields.from: sources.csv and the responses folder of the same section
fields.how: the text of the responses file sources.csv names for this archive_url, or for the SHA256 a withheld URL gives

fields.name: v
fields.how: the answer class, status code, short content type, host, saved response or withheld address of the capture, or a label's value on it

records.name: log row
records.one: one capture, or a run of captures in a row that answer in the same status class and whose URLs differ only in cache-busting values or in one number that goes up by 1 to 3 at each step

fields.name: segs
fields.from: target_url of the run's first and last capture
fields.how: percent-decoded, a cache-busting value shown as an ellipsis, a changing number as its range, and the parts that differ from the previous distinct URL marked

fields.name: kind
fields.how: same when only cache-busting values differ, number when one number goes up

fields.name: range
fields.from: target_url of the run's first and last capture
fields.how: the changing number's first and last value

fields.name: first_time
fields.from: captured_at_utc of the run's first capture
fields.how: as the file writes it, when the row stands for a later labelled capture

fields.name: last_time
fields.from: captured_at_utc of the run's last capture

fields.name: last_url
fields.from: target_url of the run's last capture

fields.name: codes
fields.how: every status the run's captures answered, when they differ

fields.name: cited
fields.how: true when a capture of the run has a saved response body

fields.name: v
fields.how: the answer class, status code, short content type, host, saved response or withheld address of the capture, or a label's value on it

records.name: minute
records.one: one minute of one section's captures, a bar in its lane

fields.name: c
fields.from: captured_at_utc and the Colour by choice
fields.how: captures counted per UTC minute and per value of the chosen field or label after every filter, the values turned off left out

fields.name: segs
fields.how: the section's active periods, split where no capture comes for over an hour

fields.name: peak_t
fields.how: the start of the lane's first minute with the most captures

accepts.means: the capture on line <n>, opened in its section's log with its details
the capture in data row <n>, opened in its section's log with its details

units.means: one section's captures, such as 03-kansas, its lane picked and its whole log open
a section's captures between two UTC times written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, its lane brushed to them and their log open
